passages.context: Column 5 lines 4–14 were inspected in the complete transcription with breaks, uncertainty, and alternate readings intact. The bounded Hebrew sequence marks a Davidic attribution, frames the item as protective speech associated with the divine name, addresses a hostile nocturnal figure, contrasts darkness and light, and invokes confinement away from the righteous. This verifies the Qumran-Digital textual architecture, not a complete formula, translation, manuscript-image collation, DJD apparatus, reconstructed missing words, performance setting, community ownership, efficacy, ordinary practice, diagnosis, influence, continuity, equivalence with Christian exorcism, or operational instruction.
